name: AnymeX+ β (Beta)
subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
description: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.

apps.name: AnymeX+ β
apps.subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
apps.localizedDescription: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.
apps.versionDescription:
Beta v1.1.1-beta+4

- Stremio's "watched" point follows your setting
  - An episode or movie now counts as watched in Stremio at your "mark as watched" percentage from Player settings (the same point AniList uses), instead of Stremio's own 70%
- Beta 2: home rows editor, stream filters, Simkl history, lighter comments, AnymeX updates
  - Movies & TV: hide, show and reorder home rows (new button in the top bar)
  - Stream list: filter by quality and addon, sort by file size; your last pick per show (addon + quality) is marked and listed first
  - Movies and episodes finished in Movies & TV are added to your Simkl history (switch on the Stremio account page; needs Simkl login)
  - Comments are built as you scroll instead of all at once
  - Merged AnymeX's latest fixes (details page crash, window transparency, Windows download paths)
  - Weekly "AnymeX updates" check opens an issue when AnymeX has new commits to merge
